title: ServiceNow IRM Sr Engineer - Subcon
description:
Job Details 
 Role: ServiceNow IRM Sr Engineer - Subcon Location: India Experience: 6-9 Years 
 
 Role overview 
 We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow IRM Senior Engineer to contribute to the development and deployment of ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM) solutions. The role involves working across the complete development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, implementation and documentation. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with ServiceNow IRM, configurations, workflows, scripting, integrations and CMDB. You will work closely with Product Owners, Agile teams, Release Train Engineers and other stakeholders to deliver scalable and maintainable solutions aligned with business requirements. 
 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 1.ServiceNow IRM Development 
 Develop and deploy ServiceNow IRM solutions and components based on project requirements. Participate in all phases of the development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, implementation and documentation. Configure ServiceNow workflows, UI policies, ACLs and other platform components. Develop scalable and maintainable solutions following ServiceNow development best practices. Support the implementation and enhancement of Integrated Risk Management capabilities. 
 
 2.Technical Design Documentation 
 Develop technology and implementation design documentation. Prepare and maintain implementation specifications and technical documentation. Provide estimates for design, development, testing and implementation tasks. Provide technical inputs and recommendations to ensure clean and effective solution design. Contribute to architecture discussions and technical solution planning. 
 
 3.Development, Testing Code Quality 
 Undertake regular development and testing of ServiceNow configurations and code. Participate in peer code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards. Contribute to unit, integration and user acceptance testing activities. Review test scripts and provide inputs aligned with the broader testing strategy. Collaborate with testing automation teams to support effective quality assurance. 
 
 4.Integration Scripting 
 Develop and maintain ServiceNow integrations using RESTful APIs and other integration mechanisms. Work with JavaScript and other ServiceNow scripting technologies. Develop or initiate JavaScript utilities as required. Work with XML, Java, Jelly scripting and AngularJS where applicable. Support integration with enterprise systems and ServiceNow platform components. 
 
 5.Agile Release Management 
 Work with Agile Champions and Release Train Engineers to prepare configurations for production. Participate in Scrum ceremonies and follow Agile principles and practices. Use Agile tools including Rally for planning, tracking and delivery. Support release planning, implementation and production readiness activities. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery of project tasks. 
 
 6.Stakeholder Collaboration 
 Provide technical recommendations and inputs to Product Owners. Communicate complex technology solutions effectively to technical teams and senior leadership. Collaborate with development, testing, architecture and business teams. Contribute to shared project goals and successful solution delivery. 
 
 Required technical skills and competencies 
 3+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience, including ServiceNow IRM solutions/components. Strong experience with ServiceNow configurations, workflows, scripting, UI policies and ACLs. Experience with ServiceNow integrations and CMDB. Strong knowledge of JavaScript and RESTful APIs. Experience with XML, Java, Jelly scripting and AngularJS. Experience across the software development lifecycle. Strong understanding of GRC/IRM concepts and industry trends. Experience working in Agile environments. Experience with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to present complex technical solutions to technical teams and senior leaders. Overall 3+ years of software development experience. Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or another technology-related discipline. 
 
 Must have skills 
 ServiceNow IRM. ServiceNow development and configuration. ServiceNow workflows. JavaScript. RESTful APIs. UI Policies. ACLs. ServiceNow integrations. CMDB. ServiceNow scripting. Agile/Scrum experience. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA). 
 
 Good to have skills 
 Working knowledge of GCP. Rally. Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). Experience with Release Train Engineering. AngularJS. XML. Java. Jelly scripting. Machine Learning or Generative AI knowledge. Exposure to ServiceNow Now Assist. Conceptual architecture knowledge. Experience with testing automation strategies. 
 
 Desired attributes 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Solution-oriented mindset with attention to clean and maintainable design. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to different stakeholder groups. Strong collaboration skills across Agile and cross-functional teams. Strong ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

title: Problem Manager- IMS and CS Core
description:
About This Opportunity We are looking for a proactive and analytical Problem Manager – Core Domain to join our L1 NOC (Network Operations Center) team at Ericsson. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and managing recurring network problems within the Core network domain, driving root cause analysis (RCA), and implementing permanent fixes to minimize network disruptions.
You will work closely with L1, L2, and L3 technical teams, service management stakeholders, and customer teams to ensure problem resolution aligns with SLA commitments and continual service improvement goals. This is a key role in strengthening operational stability and delivering a superior network experience for Ericsson's customers.   What You Will Do 

  Own end-to-end problem lifecycle management for Core network domain incidents
  Conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring and major incidents
  Identify problem trends through incident data analysis and proactive problem detection
  Raise and manage Problem Records in the ITSM ticketing system (ServiceNow / BMC Remedy / JIRA)
  Drive Known Error identification and maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB)
  Collaborate with L1 NOC, L2, and L3 teams to facilitate timely problem investigation and resolution
  Coordinate with Core network engineers, field teams, and vendor support for problem closure
  Escalate critical or unresolved problems to senior technical leads and management as per the escalation matrix
  Interface with the customer / client teams for problem status updates and post-incident reviews
  Prepare and deliver high-quality RCA reports and Problem Management reports to internal and external stakeholders
  Document workarounds, known errors, and resolution steps in the knowledge base
  Maintain accurate problem logs, closure reports, and trend analysis records
  Support audit and compliance activities with relevant documentation 
  Analyze problem trends and recurring fault patterns to identify improvement opportunities
  Work with operations and technical teams to implement preventive actions and process improvements
  Contribute to SLA performance improvement initiatives and reduction of repeat incidents
  Participate in service review meetings and provide problem management inputs   What You Will Bring 

  Good understanding of Core network technologies – IMS, VoLTE, EPC, 4G/5G Core, CS Core, MSS, MGW, HLR/HSS
  Familiarity with telecom network architecture and end-to-end service flow in Core domain
  Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, or JIRA
  Understanding of alarm monitoring platforms and NMS/EMS tools
  Working knowledge of ITIL Problem Management processes   Experience & Qualifications 
 5-10 years of experience in telecom network operations, with at least 5 years in a Problem Management or senior NOC role
  Hands-on experience in Core domain fault management, incident analysis, or network support
  Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify patterns across large incident datasets
  Excellent written and verbal communication skills for stakeholder reporting and RCA documentation
  Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electronics / Telecommunications / Computer Science) or equivalent 
 Preferred Qualifications 
  ITIL Foundation Certification (v3 or v4) preferred
  Exposure to 24x7 NOC operations environment
  Prior experience in Managed Services / Network Operations for a telecom operator or OEM
